tools.name: search_businesses
tools.description: Search the businesses listed on Localstreet by trade or name.

tools.name: business_details
tools.description: One listed business: trade, address, phone, opening hours, open now, whether it takes callback requests.

tools.name: events_on
tools.description: What's on in the visitor's borough on a day (today, tomorrow, weekend, week, or yyyy-mm-dd).

tools.name: schools_near
tools.description: Schools in the visitor's area from our hub data (Ofsted, phase, faith character, address), nearest first.

tools.name: catchment_check
tools.description: Whether a postcode was inside a school's last admissions distance. Says when that data is not available yet.

tools.name: noticeboard_search
tools.description: Live posts on the borough's noticeboard (for sale, free, wanted, local help).

tools.name: area_now
tools.description: What is happening in the area right now: line disruption and flood warnings, with how fresh each is.
